turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for agreeing to meet in person.
I didn't agree to anything. You asked, and I came. Who decided on the zero?
I'll admit I looked you up. Your firm's appellate record is remarkable.
Flattery won't answer my question. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Someone with your training will appreciate that I'm simply following the evidence. I expect you'd do the same in my position.
Then show me the evidence. What do you have, and when was Owen asked about it?
